name: Blur Rise Words
description: Headline words rise 28px out of a 14px blur, staggered; the subline follows; words exit upward into blur.
move: Headline words rise 28px out of a 14px blur, staggered; the subline follows; words exit upward into blur.
how: Words split into inline-block spans with real spaces between. fromTo y 28→0 and blur(14px)→blur(0) over 1.1s, stagger 0.075, ease cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); opacity runs as a separate, shorter 0.55s power1.out tween so no word ghosts while it settles. Subline repeats at smaller values from 0.95s. Exit at 3.35s: y -18, blur 10px, opacity 0, power2.in, stagger 0.035.
adapt: Swap headline and subline strings; the stagger scales with word count. Keep opacity shorter than motion. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Blur In by word" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
